reason: The done-gate blocked this session three times: no check ran after the commit, the engine was not installed in the fresh cloud container, and a long fast-checks run was left unfinished while the agent tried to end. Absorbed into verify-before-done as its fast-checks section; its runtime-file and environment notes moved to references/gate-details.md. Archived, not destroyed.
